asked.item: What to do if it still fails

verdict.reason: The help page covers a missing Meta privacy menu label and says not to reset all settings or remove a working connection to find it.

steps.text: Meta's privacy labels differ between account versions, so the setting may not appear under the name you were given.
Read the exact message on the platform's authorization screen.
If the message requires a privacy-setting change, follow its current Accounts Center link.
Do not reset all settings or remove a working connection to find an old menu label.

If the setting or authorization still fails, send support the message, affected platform, timestamp, and failing page's hostname and path, and leave out callback codes, state values, tokens, and passwords.
